newsitem.title: sri lanka: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga says devolution of power only choice for political settlement of ethnic problem.
Opposition leader Ranil Wickremasinghe says United National Party (UNP) opposes holding of non-binding referendum on government's devolution package to end ethnic war.
Ruling People's Alliance, opposition UNP, Mahajana Eksath Peramuna and Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna parties to contest polls for all 238 local government bodies outside north and east in March.
Customs nab Indian national trying to smuggle six million rupees worth of foreign currency to Singapore.
Opposition leader Ranil Wickremasinghe says his UNP supports 60 percent of government's devolution proposals to end ethnic war.
